source: Owner direct chat after discussion of GASP 5.8, retained balance, disarming and wound gestures
owner_message_original: Создай задачи, вперед всего перенос гасп на противников, на счет выбивания оружия и хватания за рану это уже второстепенно
owner_message_english_translation: Create the tasks; migrating GASP to enemies comes first. Weapon disarming and clutching a wound are secondary.
preceding_architecture_question_original: Тогда нам стоит взять настроеные маникены из гасп и к ним прекрутить логику что мы написали для баланса?
preceding_feature_question_original: А мы сможем потом добавить такую вещь как выбивание оружия из рук и хватание противника за то место, куда его ранили?
accepted_discussion_context: Use the configured GASP 5.8 physical character as the proposed enemy foundation and adapt existing balance/recovery and combat logic, with a single authority for body drives and movement. Start with one pilot, then migrate current fixtures after affected checks. The wound reaction means the enemy reaches for its own injured region.
decision: Create three tasks. Make GASP enemy migration the next highest-priority implementation candidate; keep disarming and hand-to-wound reactions as separate low-priority follow-ups.
controller_ordering: Three unstaged children of MSQ-67. Migration consumes delivered MSQ-92/current follow-ups and precedes MSQ-93 and MSQ-70. MSQ-70 retains MSQ-69 as an additional prerequisite. Keep MSQ-93 through MSQ-96 and the existing MSQ-70 onward relative order. Both secondary tasks consume migration and MSQ-70; neither blocks base combat or depends on the other.
authorization: Task creation, descriptions, priorities, dependencies and planning records only. New tasks stay backlog and unassigned with zero runs. Do not dispatch implementation/review or start the task runtime as part of preparation.
scope_interpretation: Migration includes a bounded flat-floor locomotion/physical recovery handover and rollout to the current three fixtures. AI pursuit/firing remains MSQ-70, expanded counterbalance and terrain remain MSQ-93 through MSQ-96, parkour gameplay and AnimGen remain outside these tasks. Enemy-side movement framework adaptation is part of future migration scope; player movement/presentation is retained.
review: Future substantive execution uses executor self-checks, one primary independent technical reviewer and controller acceptance at verified max reasoning and standard speed. Existing review waivers are not expanded. Owner motion/play judgement remains separate.
preservation: Preserve the current baseline including post-MSQ-92 cadence correction, owner edits, three fixture/profile identities, original GASP/Mixamo/Manny sources, historical candidates/evidence, purchased arms, lobby and app sessions. No gameplay or asset migration occurs during task preparation.
